correctness.rationale: The exact formula \(H(p^a)=\sum_{j=0}^{a-1}p^{2j}-p^{a-1}\) classifies prime powers. For \(p^aq^b\), the exact four-term expansion gives value \(2\) when \(a=b=1\), lower bound \(34\) with unique equality at \(2^2\cdot3\) when the smaller block repeats, and lower bound \(41\) when only the larger block repeats. The coprime-block recursion is strictly increasing beyond the scaled prior value, which excludes all support size at least three below \(34\).
